title: Controlled direct-backend fallback
summary: Provided explicit controls for interconnect actions that require direct Configuration Engine execution.

dates.note: Individual implementation dates are not established; the supplied engineering analysis is an October 5, 2026 snapshot.

facts.text: Implemented controlled direct-Configuration Engine fallback with content-bound execution and supporting evidence.
Enabled agent-led configuration creation and import/modify/diagnose workflows with backend fallback.

notes: Fallback is a separate mechanism from checkpoint rollback and current/legacy Python runtime routing; a rollback hash result is not a fallback benchmark.
